name: pkulaw
description: Semantic (natural-language) + keyword dual-mode retrieval over Chinese laws, regulations and judicial cases, plus citation verification: extract and standardise statute references, validate case numbers, fact-check article text against the authoritative original, and auto-link everything back to pkulaw.com — traceable, verifiable, ready to cite.
